author: Unity
description:
This quick-tip short introduces you to the Localization package that allows a Unity game to support multiple languages. The package can be installed directly from the Unity Package Manager and is easy to get started with.

Find more free Unity Learn resources: https://on.unity.com/Learn

#GameDev #UnityTips #Unity3d #UnityLearn #VideoGameLocalization
title: The Unity Localization package is the easiest way to support multiple languages 🌍

author: Unity
description: Want to add multiplayer to your game, but not sure where to start? Join Mark and Luke from Photon, along with Sarah from Pro-Training at Unity to learn just how easy it can be to add multiplayer to your game using Photon Engine! We’ll explore the state of multiplayer in 2026 and take a closer look at Photon Fusion and Photon Quantum, highlighting how they help simplify one of game development’s biggest challenges. Whether you’re building your first multiplayer experience or looking for the right solution for your next project, this stream will give you practical insights to help you get started faster and build with confidence.
title: Asset Showcase: Photon Engine
